statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of homepage, section, article, weather utility and invalid-route recovery. Excluded: paywalled Plus article completion, login/account management, checkout/subscription purchase, video playback and the full settings subflow because they are distinct authenticated/commercial/media journeys beyond this public-path run.

Weather route; represents the main data/interactive utility surface.

findings.summary: The consent dialog blocks every representative primary path on a fresh visit.
findings.evidence: Desktop and 360x800 screenshots show a large modal covering the homepage, section, article and weather content before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the blocking first-load wall with a compact, content-first consent surface where legally possible; keep essential content usable and provide clear dismiss/reject controls using a semantic dialog.

findings.summary: The experience does not react to the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The default and prefers-color-scheme: dark homepage screenshots are byte-identical; the consent UI stays a fixed light surface while the underlying site stays fixed dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() tokens for the page and consent UI, preserving contrast in both schemes.

findings.summary: Motion continues when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The evaluate probe under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce reports a running animation with a 2750ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential animation in no-preference and remove or shorten it under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Red-on-dark navigation and labels fail minimum text contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found four contrast failures at 3.54:1, including KIRJAUDU, selected navigation and category labels where 4.5:1 is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust the red or dark surface tokens to reach at least 4.5:1 for normal text and verify forced-colors/high-contrast states.

findings.summary: Primary route and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no view-transition declarations or API usage on a multi-route news site with stateful feed tabs.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance article navigation and feed-tab changes with same-document/cross-document View Transitions, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Dense global chrome and promotional surfaces compete with the news content.
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshots devote two navigation rows, a persistent bottom bar and a large Plus promotion to chrome before the first story, even before counting the consent modal.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary navigation into a clear menu on narrow screens and reserve first-view space for the lead content and primary section choices.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-driven rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: The DOM/platform probe found no container-query rules while the same card/navigation patterns are reused across columns and mobile layouts.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable card/list regions and use @container rules so components adapt to their allocated space rather than only global breakpoints.

findings.summary: Several important controls have no visible focus indicator and some targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The focus probe measured KIRJAUDU and menu buttons with outline none; the menu control was 30x22px in one state, below a comfortable 44px touch target.
findings.suggestedFix: Use :focus-visible with a high-contrast outline and enlarge interactive hit areas to at least 44x44 CSS pixels without relying on hover.

findings.summary: Homepage loading is slow and visually unstable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.8s and CLS 0.512; its shift diagnostics identify a late news container, web fonts and images without explicit size. The independent trace measured LCP 3.87s.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve media/ad/feed space, set image dimensions/aspect-ratio, stabilise font fallbacks, and prioritise the actual LCP image while deferring non-critical ad work.

findings.summary: Advertising and account bundles dominate delivery and ship substantial unused JavaScript.
findings.evidence: HAR reports 648KB of scripts and 703KB of 1.04MB transferred from third-party origins; Lighthouse estimates 281KiB unused JavaScript, led by prebid and ATS bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Load advertising/account features conditionally after consent and proximity/intent, split bundles, remove legacy/duplicate code, and lower non-critical priorities.

findings.summary: Article imagery is not consistently exposed to assistive technology.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 7 of 18 images without alt text; several are article recommendation thumbnails rather than clearly decorative assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide meaningful alt text for informative images and explicit empty alt for decorative images; ensure image links retain an accessible name.

findings.summary: Homepage heading structure and keyboard focus treatment are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The rendered homepage had no H1, while the focus probe showed outline:none on key sign-in and menu buttons.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive H1 for the page/feed and restore a logical heading hierarchy and strong :focus-visible treatment in reading order.

findings.summary: Images omit intrinsic dimensions and contribute to layout shift.
findings.evidence: The article image audit found all 18 images lacked width/height attributes; Lighthouse directly attributed a large homepage shift to an image lacking explicit size.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height (or a stable aspect-ratio wrapper) from image metadata and validate responsive sizing without distorting aspect ratios.

findings.summary: Article entities lack JSON-LD structured data and much feed content is absent from raw HTML.
findings.evidence: Metadata probe found accurate title/canonical/Open Graph but zero JSON-LD blocks; discoverability measured only 14% raw/rendered token coverage on the homepage and 39% on the article.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the primary feed/article text and add accurate NewsArticle JSON-LD matching visible headline, dates, author, image and publisher metadata.

findings.summary: Browser security policy headers leave avoidable gaps.
findings.evidence: Header audit found CSP limited to frame-ancestors (no script/object/base protections), missing X-Content-Type-Options and Permissions-Policy, and a permissive no-referrer-when-downgrade policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforcing CSP for scripts/objects/base-uri, add nosniff and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, and use strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter referrer policy.

findings.summary: Third-party ad and analytics activity begins while the consent wall is still displayed.
findings.evidence: Initial-load evidence records 11 third-party origins, 35/40 HAR requests and 703KB transferred to third parties, including ATS and visitor analytics, before the user accepts.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential analytics/ad requests on consent, minimise vendors and identifiers, batch necessary measurements, and document each third party in the settings UI.

findings.summary: The installable/offline surface is incomplete for a frequently used news utility.
findings.evidence: A manifest exists but has an empty name and no start_url; the probe found no controlling service worker, so no offline fallback was evident.
findings.suggestedFix: Complete the manifest identity/start URL and add a conservative service worker that provides an offline reading shell/fallback without caching personalised or consent-sensitive responses.

findings.evidence: The mobile dialog gives a large green Hyväksy button and a muted Asetukset button, with no equally direct reject action despite listing 87 partners and broad tracking purposes.
findings.suggestedFix: Present accept and reject at the same hierarchy on the first layer, use neutral styling, and make granular choices and withdrawal as easy as acceptance.

findings.summary: Article assets are not consistently resolution- or format-optimised.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 14 legacy PNG/JPEG assets, 2 oversized images, 2 missing responsive sources and 4 below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP where useful, emit srcset/sizes from the image CDN, lazy-load below-fold media, and match requested dimensions to rendered size.

taskList.title: Gate third parties and redesign consent as a balanced, non-blocking choice
Stabilise media/feed layout and improve LCP
Restore accessible contrast, focus, target sizes and image alternatives
Harden CSP and browser policy headers
Server-render more primary content and add NewsArticle JSON-LD
Support user color and motion preferences
Reduce mobile chrome and add component-aware responsiveness
Complete manifest and add a safe offline fallback
Progressively enhance state changes with View Transitions
